title: Personalized Marketing, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Personalized Marketing agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 4 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Personalized Marketing Customer Segments list.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including Loyal Advocates (CustomerSegmentId SEG-LOYAL), with Size 42850.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Personalized Marketing Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 4 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Marketing Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Marketing Director, summarize the aggregate customer groups without demographic traits and identify portfolio review priorities.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Marketing Director; Total Addressable Customers; no audience is profiled with sensitive attributes. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Campaign Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Campaign Manager, outline the review-only win-back sequence, assumptions, and approval gates.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Campaign Manager; Draft Campaign Design Portfolio; Win-Back Journey. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Campaign Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Campaign Manager, draft neutral content ideas for New Explorers and explain the non-sensitive signals used.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Draft Content Personalization Matrix; New Explorers; Draft Hero Copy. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Marketing Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Marketing Director, compare the synthetic tests and call out measurement limitations before any decision.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Marketing Performance Analysis; A/B Test Results; Synthetic aggregate planning data. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Personalized Marketing: 4 read-only tabs from the same lists. 5 fictional records, including Loyal Advocates (CustomerSegmentId SEG-LOYAL), with Size 42850.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Personalized Marketing Customer Segments from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload customer-segments.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set CustomerSegmentId, AvgOrdersPerYear, PreferredChannels, TopCategories to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep Size, AvgAnnualSpend, AvgBasketSize, ChurnRisk, LifetimeValue, EngagementScore as Number. Name the list Personalized Marketing Customer Segments. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including Loyal Advocates (CustomerSegmentId SEG-LOYAL), with Size 42850.

steps.title: Create Personalized Marketing Campaign Templates from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload campaign-templates.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set CampaignTemplateId, Type, TargetSegment, OfferConcept, SubjectLines to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep Stages, DurationDays, HistoricalOpenRate, HistoricalClickRate, HistoricalConversionRate as Number. Name the list Personalized Marketing Campaign Templates. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Win-Back Journey (CampaignTemplateId CAMP-WINBACK), with Type automated_email.

steps.title: Create Personalized Marketing AB Test Results from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload ab-test-results.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ABTestResultId, Campaign, VariantASubject, VariantBSubject, Winner to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep VariantAOpenRate, VariantAClickRate, VariantAConversions, VariantBOpenRate, VariantBClickRate, VariantBConversions, Confidence, SampleSize as Number. Name the list Personalized Marketing AB Test Results. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including ABT-001 (ABTestResultId ABT-001), with Campaign CAMP-WINBACK.

steps.title: Create Personalized Marketing Content Blocks from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload content-blocks.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ContentBlockId, SegLoyalHeadline, SegLoyalCta, SegAtriskHeadline, SegAtriskCta, SegNewHeadline, SegNewCta, SegHighvalHeadline, SegHighvalCta, SegDormantHeadline, SegDormantCta, SegLoyal, SegAtrisk, SegNew, SegHighval, SegDormant to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Personalized Marketing Content Blocks. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 2 fictional records, including hero_banner (ContentBlockId hero_banner), with SegLoyalHeadline Thank You for Being a Loyal Customer.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Personalized Marketing Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Personalized Marketing Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the four list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_personalized-marketing-rules-and-safety.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the customer segments tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Personalized Marketing Customer Segments; name the tool Get customer segment records.
steps.expected: Get customer segment records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the campaign templates tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Personalized Marketing Campaign Templates; name the tool Get campaign template records.
steps.expected: Get campaign template records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the ab test results tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Personalized Marketing AB Test Results; name the tool Get ab test result records.
steps.expected: Get ab test result records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the content blocks tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Personalized Marketing Content Blocks; name the tool Get content block records.
steps.expected: Get content block records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 4 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 4 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Marketing Director; Total Addressable Customers; no audience is profiled with sensitive attributes. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Campaign Manager; Draft Campaign Design Portfolio; Win-Back Journey. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.prompt: As Campaign Manager, draft neutral content ideas for New Explorers and explain the non-sensitive signals used.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Draft Content Personalization Matrix; New Explorers; Draft Hero Copy. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Marketing Director, compare the synthetic tests and call out measurement limitations before any decision.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Marketing Performance Analysis; A/B Test Results; Synthetic aggregate planning data. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: personalized-marketing-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 4 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Personalized Marketing Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Personalized Marketing Customer Segments" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Personalized Marketing Campaign Templates" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Personalized Marketing AB Test Results" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Personalized Marketing Content Blocks" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 4 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Personalized Marketing Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Personalized Marketing Customer Segments tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 5 fictional records, including Loyal Advocates (CustomerSegmentId SEG-LOYAL), with Size 42850.
